remarks: PET FRIENDLY! PRICE INCLUDES ELECTRICITY & WATER! Welcome to residential 10 Sachem St located in the Spring Hill/West Norwalk neighborhood in Norwalk. Just walking distance to/from Kendall Elementary School. Commuter friendly being just a short drive to I95, Rt 7, CT AVE, SONO & both East/South Norwalk Train Stations. This single family includes a total of 4 spacious bedrooms & 2 full bathrooms (1 on each level). This is a 3 level Cape Cod style home that has 2 beds, 1 full bath, living room, family room, dining area & walk-out to back 18x18 rear deck on main level. Upper level includes 2 large bedrooms with plenty of closet/storage space and a full bath. Lower/Ground level entertains interior access to garage (shared storage only) & laundry room. Tenants responsible for ground maintenance/snow removal. Central Air, Laundry + Off-Street parking for tenants comfort. **Owner is in process of having property professionally cleaned & painted**
